working_definition: T4d is one of four directional subtypes (a-d) of T4 neurons in the Drosophila optic lobe. It is a columnar, ON-pathway, direction-selective neuron whose dendrites arborise in medulla layer M10 and whose axon terminals project specifically to lobula plate layer 4 (layer d). The four T4 subtypes encode cardinal directions of visual motion; T4d encodes downward motion read out in lobula plate layer 4.

best_match.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: FBbt:00003735 'T4d neuron' is defined as the T4 subtype with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 that responds to downward motion (Fischbach and Dittrich 1989; Henning et al. 2022). The atlas cluster 'T4d' is defined identically: a T4 (ON-pathway) columnar optic lobe neuron whose axon terminals target lobula plate layer d (layer 4) and which encodes the corresponding cardinal direction of downward motion. The label, layer specificity, and directional tuning all match precisely. The FBbt term is not obsolete and is a direct subtype of T4 neuron (FBbt:00003731). Unlike T4a, no further sub-subtypes (T4di/T4dii) exist in FBbt, so FBbt:00003735 is the most specific available term and the cluster maps cleanly at this level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its cell body posterior to the lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects through the lobula plate and via the second optic chiasma, with little or no arborization, to medulla layer 10 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It forms a fine arborization in medulla layers M9 and M10 and its axon then doubles back across the second optic chiasma to form bleb-type arborizations in a single layer of the lobula plate (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It is a cholinergic neuron (Mauss et al., 2014; Shinomiya et al., 2014). There are a large number of these cells, which are generated from neuroblasts that amplify by symmetric division (type III) before generating the T4 (and T5) neurons (Mora et al., 2018).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent term covering all four T4 subtypes (a-d); the cluster 'T4d' is specifically the layer-4 subtype. Using the parent would be a broad match and would lose the defining layer-identity information that is central to this cluster's annotation.

recommendation: Map cluster T4d to FBbt:00003735 (T4d neuron) with skos:exactMatch. The label, lobula plate layer-4 targeting, and downward direction-selectivity all correspond precisely. No new FBbt term is needed.
